blind_spots.blind_spot: Pathfinder markets absolute positioning delivered 'with every frame of imagery' as a selling point, with no stated compute/power budget for the SWaP-constrained platform actually running it.
blind_spots.operator_reality: Continuous per-frame vision-model inference is a battery and thermal cost on a man-portable or small-UAS platform; the canonical DDIL failure mode (30fps crowd-detection streaming into 1-frame-per-5-seconds bandwidth) is the same class of problem here but on the power/compute axis instead of comms — nothing on the site addresses what happens when compute has to throttle.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Messaging is built to showcase precision and responsiveness for demos and pitch competitions, not the SWaP-C tradeoffs of the deployed hardware.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Pathfinder™ delivers precise absolute location coordinates (latitude and longitude) with every frame of imagery—whether you need updates every millisecond or every 10 minutes.

blind_spots.blind_spot: The product line sits an unrestricted commercial iOS consumer app directly beside a military ATAK plugin with no visible ITAR/export-control or CMMC/NIST 800-171 framing anywhere on the site.
blind_spots.operator_reality: A dual-use nav tech company pursuing DARPA ERIS marketplace and Sole-Source Phase 3 SBIR/STTR status will hit export-control classification and CMMC company-level compliance requirements before that Phase III money lands; if unresolved, the contract clock (EDP: months-to-field vs. funded months remaining) runs out waiting on paperwork, not engineering.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Team is ~6-12 people focused on R&D and pitch competitions; compliance overhead is the kind of thing that gets deferred until a contracting officer forces it.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Pathfinder iOS app - For commercial-military use ... Pathfinder on TAK - Plugin for US military use

blind_spots.blind_spot: Navigation accuracy depends on 'preexisting and pre-downloaded satellite datasets from around the world' with no mention of how that reference data gets refreshed, verified, or trusted by an operator in an unfamiliar AO.
blind_spots.operator_reality: An E-5 trusting a blue-dot replacement needs to know the reference imagery for today's AO isn't six months stale before they stake a route on it; no training/verification workflow is described, only the technical mechanism, which is exactly the operator-trust gap that kills adoption even when the underlying tech works.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Company frames the product around technical capability and awards, not the field-trust and sustainment loop that turns a demo into something a unit will actually rely on.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Scalable and GPS-Independent: By leveraging preexisting and pre-downloaded satellite datasets from around the world, Pathfinder™ provides a scalable solution for global navigation

opener_hook: Skyline Nav AI's AFRL SBIR Phase II funds Pathfinder's ATAK integration for GPS-denied ops. What does the Phase III transition plan look like?
what_they_do: GPS-independent visual/inertial navigation software (Pathfinder) for drones, ground vehicles, and aircraft, with an ATAK plugin funded by AFRL/USAF SBIR and STTR contracts.
